action: CareRide of the Valley offered formal onboarding conversation; followed up with Robert Jackson for internal contacts; continued rideshare driving for bridge income
narrative: CareRide of the Valley called Grace back this tick — a dispatcher named Marcus Webb reached out to schedule a formal onboarding orientation and background check for next week, citing her NEMT certification and clean record as exactly what they need for a new Millfield General route they are launching. Millfield Medical Transport has not yet responded, but Marcus at CareRide told her the orientation-to-first-route timeline is typically five to seven days once paperwork clears. Robert Jackson responded to Grace's text with the name of his direct contact at CareRide — ironically the same Marcus Webb who already called — and confirmed the operator is actively expanding. Grace drove morning airport windows and one Friday surge block, generating approximately $380 in rideshare income this tick, which partially offsets the $1,787 monthly burn while onboarding finalizes.
